title: The Rendlesham Forest Incident
hook: December 1980, US Air Force guards saw mysterious lights over a British forest, and the evidence didn't add up.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In December 1980, US Air Force personnel reported strange lights over Rendlesham Forest.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: On the night of December 26, a luminous object hovered near a wooden telephone pole, leaving scorch marks.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Radar operators at RAF Bentwaters recorded a moving blip matching the object's speed, around 1,500 meters away.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Witness Sgt. Jim Pennant later described the craft as a metallic triangle with hieroglyphic symbols.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Investigators later noted a NATO exercise that night, but the scorch marks on the ground were never fully explained.

end.line: What do you think caused the Rendlesham lights?

description: US Air Force witnesses strange lights over Rendlesham Forest in 1980.

facts.claim: The incident occurred in December 1980 when US Air Force personnel reported strange lights over Rendlesham Forest.
On the night of December 26, a luminous object hovered near a telephone pole, leaving scorch marks on the ground.
Radar operators at RAF Bentwaters recorded a moving blip matching the object's speed, about 1,500 meters away.
Sgt. Jim Pennant described the craft as a metallic triangle with hieroglyphic symbols.
A NATO exercise was taking place that night, possibly accounting for some lights.
The scorch marks on the ground have never been fully explained by investigators.
